events.verdict: Jokic (DEN) places his off-arm against Gobert (MIN), who loses his balance as a result of the incidental foot contact with Jokic. Jokic does not extend his arm into Gobert to dislodge him from his defensive position.
Edwards (MIN) avoids making any illegal contact with Jokic (DEN) during his shot attempt in the paint.
Watson (DEN) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) makes contact with the part of Gobert's (MIN) hand that is not on the ball, which pulls his hand off the ball and affects his shot attempt in the paint.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) legally contests Braun's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) does not step out of bounds while in possession of the ball.
McDaniels (MIN) releases the jump shot attempt and Braun's (DEN) right hand appears to graze McDaniels' head/face following his contest of the jump shot.
Gobert (MIN) momentarily grasps and releases the front of Jokic's (DEN) jersey during the rebounding opportunity and the contact on the play is marginal.

events.category: Turnover: Lost Ball Out of Bounds
events.verdict: McDaniels (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.

Alexander-Walker (MIN) establishes himself in a legal guarding position prior to Gordon (DEN) moving into his space during the inbound play. The two players come together and Gordon loses his balance on his own accord.
Westbrook (DEN) brushes Gobert's (MIN) arm prior to his pass.
Edwards (MIN) establishes the ball in the frontcourt, but then steps back onto the midcourt line.

Braun (DEN) establishes himself in a legal defensive position outside of the restricted area prior to Edwards (MIN) moving into and through Braun. The resulting contact dislodges Braun from his legal guarding position during the driving shot attempt.
Braun (DEN) establishes himself in a legal screening position and does not deliver any illegal contact when setting the screen on Randle (MIN).
Gobert (MIN) jumps forward and turns his body into Jokic (DEN), initiating illegal body contact during Jokic's shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) gathers the pass in the air and maintains his right foot as his pivot foot prior to releasing the ball to start his dribble.
Watson (DEN) legally contests Randle's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) releases his pass and Randle (MIN) extends his right leg and out and intentionally kicks the ball.
Edwards (MIN) lowers his arm down toward the ball and the contact with Watson's (DEN) arm after he releases his shot attempt is marginal.
Randle (MIN) establishes himself in a legal screening position and then comes together with Braun (DEN) as he turns to roll towards the basket. The contact on the play is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) is holding his off-arm out when he stops his forward momentum and marginal contact occurs with Jokic (DEN) at the end of the drive.
Braun (DEN) legally contests Edwards' (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) establishes himself in Alexander-Walker's (MIN) path and marginal contact occurs as the two come together and disengage during the pick.
Edwards (MIN) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) and McDaniels (MIN) momentarily engage off ball.
Westbrook (DEN) dislodges the ball from Alexander-Walker's (MIN) possession and any ensuing contact with Alexander-Walker's wrist is incidental.
Watson (DEN) momentarily rests and removes his hand from Edwards' (MIN) right arm and the contact as Edwards receives the pass is marginal.
Watson (DEN) contests Edwards' (MIN) driving shot attempt and any contact that occurs to Edwards' head after the release is marginal.
Jokic (DEN) collapses his forearm as he contests Edwards' (MIN) layup attempt and the contact is marginal.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) legally contests Gordon's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) shot attempt in the paint.
Edwards (MIN) reaches across Watson's (DEN) back and makes illegal contact to his arm.
Edwards (MIN) raises his right arm up towards the ball and marginal contact occurs with Jokic's (DEN) right arm after the release of his shot attempt in the paint.
Randle (MIN) firms up over his right leg in a screening position and marginal contact occurs as Westbrook (DEN) defends around the screen.
Gordon (DEN) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) jump shot attempt.

Watson (DEN) cleanly blocks Alexander-Walker's (MIN) put-back attempt at the basket. The contact with the ball, which results in the ball coming loose, precedes any arm contact with Alexander-Walker and thus that contact is considered incidental.
Westbrook (DEN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Westbrook (DEN) cleanly dislodges the ball from McDaniels (MIN) during his initial shot attempt near the basket.
After Westbrook (DEN) dislodges the ball, McDaniels (MIN) legally recovers it before releasing his shot attempt at the basket.
Westbrook (DEN) legally contests McDaniels' (MIN) shot attempt at the basket.
Conley (MIN) makes clean contact with the ball to deflect it away from Jokic (DEN) and any ensuing contact with his arm is considered incidental.
There is no clear and conclusive video evidence that confirms that Conley (MIN) is not the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds.
Alexander-Walker (MIN) legally contests Jokic's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Watson (DEN) goes into the air in pursuit of the loose ball and marginal contact occurs with Randle (MIN) as Randle returns to the ground in possession of the ball.

Jokic (DEN) jumps straight into the air as he raises his arms into a legal vertical position. Jokic maintains his legal vertical position while absorbing the contact with Edwards (MIN) during Edwards' layup attempt.
Westbrook (DEN) briefly places a hand over Edwards' (MIN) shoulder and immediately removes it and the contact during his layup attempt is marginal.
Edwards (MIN) extends his right arm forward and makes contact with Jokic's (DEN) right shoulder, which affects his control of the ball during his drive.
Conley (MIN) legally contests Gordon's (DEN) jump shot attempt.
Jokic (DEN) is in the paint for longer than three seconds without imminently actively guarding an opponent.
Braun (DEN) legally contests Alexander-Walker's (MIN) jump shot attempt.
Conley (MIN) moves forward into Westbrook (DEN) and initiates illegal body contact that affects his shot attempt.
Randle (MIN) is the last player to touch the ball before it goes out of bounds and possession should have been awarded to Denver.
McDaniels (MIN) grabs and pulls Jokic's (DEN) right arm, which affects his ability to compete for the jump ball.
Conley (MIN) cuts across Westbrook's (DEN) path and avoids making any illegal contact with Westbrook while contesting the layup attempt at the basket.

Westbrook (DEN) closes out into Alexander-Walker's (MIN) space during the jump shot attempt and makes illegal contact before he returns to the floor. After communicating with the Replay Center, it is determined that the illegal contact by Westbrook occurs prior to the game clock expiring with 0.1 seconds remaining.
